with an air of importance.definitionKo: 잘난 체하며 자꾸 버릇없이 구는 모양.
with an air of importance.englishDescription: In the manner of behaving affectedly and impolitely.
with an air of importance.englishExpression: in a cocky way; with an air of importance

with one furtive glance.definitionKo: 눈을 옆으로 돌려 슬쩍 한 번 쳐다보는 모양.
with one furtive glance.englishDescription: A word describing the motion of directing the eyes sideways and looking furtively at something one time.

with slow and slight moves.definitionKo: 몸을 천천히 작게 계속 움직이는 모양.
with slow and slight moves.englishDescription: A word describing the motion of continuously moving the body slowly and slightly.

woods.englishDescription: A dense forest with many tall trees.
A densely wooded area covered with trees and plants.

woods.definitionKo: 나무나 풀이 빽빽하게 많이 나 있는 곳.
woods.englishDescription: A densely wooded area covered with trees and plants.

word for embellishment.definitionKo: 언어에서, 더 분명하고 아름답게 표현하기 위해서 꾸미는 말.
word for embellishment.englishDescription: In language, a word that modifies to make expressions clearer and more beautiful.
word for embellishment.englishExpression: word for embellishment; word for decoration

words open into each other.englishDescription: To be able to communicate with each other.

work to do.englishDescription: A piece of work that one should do.

written diagnosis.definitionKo: 의사가 환자를 검사하여 건강 상태를 판단한 결과를 적은 증명서.
written diagnosis.englishDescription: A certificate giving details of a patient's health after a doctor examines him/her.

yeongseo.englishDescription: The region in the west of Daegwallyeong Pass in Gangwon-do, or Gangwon Province.

you.definitionKo: (조금 높이는 말로) 듣는 사람을 가리키는 말.
you.englishDescription: (formal, slightly addressee-raising) A pronoun used to indicate the listener.

you.definitionKo: (낮잡아 이르는 말로) 듣는 사람을 가리키는 말.
you.englishDescription: (disparaging) A pronoun used to indicate the listener.

you.definitionKo: (아주 높이는 말로) 앞에서 이미 말한 사람을 도로 가리키는 말.
you.englishDescription: (formal, highly addressee-raising) A pronoun used to indicate the person mentioned earlier.
(polite form) A pronoun used to indicate the listener.

you.definitionKo: 듣는 사람이 친구나 아랫사람들일 때, 그 사람들을 가리키는 말.
you.englishDescription: A pronoun used to indicate the listeners when they are the same age or younger.

you.definitionKo: (높이는 말로) 듣는 사람이 대등한 관계에 있는 사람이나 아랫사람일 때, 그 사람을 가리키는 말.
you.englishDescription: (polite form) When a listener is on equal terms with or younger than the speaker, or a term that addresses that person.

you.definitionKo: (높이는 말로) 나이가 비슷하면서 잘 모르는 사람이나, 아랫사람을 가리키는 말.
you.englishDescription: (polite form) A word used to refer to a person who is similar to the speaker in age and the speaker is not acquainted with, or who is junior to the speaker.

you.definitionKo: 지도자나 통솔자가 여러 명의 아랫사람을 조금 높여 가리키는 말.
you.englishDescription: A somewhat honorific form of a word used by a leader or commander when calling a group of his/her subordinates.
A form of '너' (you), when the postpositional particle '가' is attached to it.

you cannot deceive your lineage.definitionKo: 유전으로 이어받는 집안 내력은 숨기려 해도 숨길 수 없다.
you cannot deceive your lineage.englishDescription: It is hard to conceal the traits or the character that has been inherited from the family.

young man.englishDescription: A person of a young age.
